meta.title: Source registry — official / primary sources only
meta.policy: A row may only carry a value if an official NFL source states it. Statistical models are labelled 'model output' and are never presented as facts. Third-party aggregators, social posts and memory are not used as evidence.
meta.official_tier: nfl.com and operations.nfl.com (the league's own sites)
meta.secondary_tier: League-issued statements republished by NFL.com newsroom (still nfl.com URLs)

sources.title: NFL 2026 Division Standings
sources.used_for: W-L-T, PCT, PF, PA, Net Pts, home/road/div/conf splits, streak, last 5 — for all 32 clubs
sources.notes: All eight divisions are rendered on this single page. Snapshot does not include the Week 10 Thursday game.

sources.title: NFL 2026 League Standings
sources.used_for: Cross-check of the same club-level figures in a different sort order
sources.notes: Second official rendering used to confirm the division-page values match.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report — Week 10, 2026 season
sources.used_for: Player, position, injury, practice status, game status — for all 28 clubs playing in Week 10
sources.notes: Only clubs scheduled in that week appear. Clubs on bye have no table.

sources.title: NFL 2026 Schedule — Week 10
sources.used_for: Fixture list, kickoff time, broadcast network, venue/international designation, final scores where published
sources.notes: Kickoff times are Eastern as published by NFL.com. Individual game pages follow /games/<away>-at-<home>-2026-reg-10.

sources.title: NFL 2026 Schedule by week — Week 10
sources.used_for: Bye-week confirmation (clubs absent from the Week 10 slate)
sources.notes: URL published in NFL.com navigation; not independently fetched on 2026-11-14. Bye clubs are instead derived from the verified Week 10 fixture list and flagged as derived.

sources.title: NFL Injury Report Policy (operations)
sources.used_for: Intended source for practice-status definitions and reporting deadlines
sources.notes: Returned an empty body on 2026-11-14. Policy language is therefore NOT quoted anywhere on this site. See flag F06.

sources.title: NFL news roundup: Ravens confirm Lamar Jackson expected to miss 6-10 weeks
sources.used_for: Evidence that a starting QB absence can be absent from the injury table
sources.notes: Headline captured from the Week 10 injury page's news module.

sources.title: Sam Darnold ruled out for Seahawks' Week 10 game vs. Raiders
sources.used_for: Quarterback change confirmation for SEA @ LV
sources.notes: Headline captured from the Week 10 injury page's news module.

sources.title: NFL injury report page — club tables
sources.used_for: Which clubs have a table in a given week (28 of 32 in Week 10)
sources.notes: Presence/absence of a club table is the only official signal used for bye weeks.

rejected_sources.what: Third-party odds screens, line-history aggregators, DFS projections
rejected_sources.why: Not official; no licensing; cannot be re-verified by the owner from a primary source.
rejected_sources.consequence: Market comparison, closing-line value and implied-probability extraction are unmeasurable in this build (flag F07).

rejected_sources.what: Depth charts and roster rankings published outside club/league control
rejected_sources.why: No official NFL source states a depth-chart ordinal for each player.
rejected_sources.consequence: '2nd/3rd/4th string' is expressed as an ordinal *model estimate* with a confidence band, never as fact (flag F05).
